response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software engineering, AI-agent infrastructure, and model context protocol (MCP) work, aligning well with the role's technical stack and leadership requirements. However, his background is more general AI/software engineering rather than explicitly GenAI-focused, and he lacks direct experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent system frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI. His recent role at re:cinq involves MCP tools, which is a plus, but his GenAI-specific contributions are not clearly documented.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience with TypeScript/Python (Node.js, AWS CDK) in enterprise environments
Recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP (Model Context Protocol) code generators
Proven leadership in technical discovery, mentorship, and engineering excellence (Staff roles at re:cinq and Altom)
concerns: Limited explicit experience with GenAI-specific technologies (vector databases, RAG, multi-agent systems)
No clear evidence of building production-grade AI solutions from prototypes or leading AI discovery sessions
Background is more general software engineering rather than specialized AI/GenAI engineering
